newsitem.title: USA: Raleigh, N.C., approves university arena plan.
newsitem.headline: Raleigh, N.C., approves university arena plan.

text.p: The Raleigh, N.C., City Council agreed to give the Centennial Authority $48 million more in hotel tax revenues to complete financing of the $120 million West Raleigh Arena, a city official said Wednesday.
In exchange, the city and Wake County would receive $2 million annually in revenues from the arena to be build at North Carolina State University.
The hotel tax is leveied by Wake County, which previously approved the financing plan.
The 21,000-seat arena would be the new home of the North Carolina State University basketball team, and possibly a National Hockey League expansion team.

The Centennial Authority will contribute the remaining $72 million for construction of the project, which it raised from state revenues, athletic booster constributions and previous revenues from the hotel tax.
A city official said financing details had yet to be worked out, but that any debt issue would be done by the Centennial Authority.
